Metadata.title: Knowledge Graph for AgentMemBank MCP Server
Metadata.approval: Architecture approved by user; Agent UX + Admin Observability extension approved 2026-05-10.

Concepts.Concept: Markdown files in Obsidian Vault are the primary durable knowledge source.
SQLite FTS, vector tables and projections can be rebuilt from Vault content.
revision equals sha256(content), not mtime or size.
Mutations require policy, plan, dry-run, revision recheck and audit.
70_Wiki receives proposals and diffs, not autonomous writes.
Delete operations are outside MVP and denied by policy.
Agent-facing Vault folder semantics and write destinations are defined by server-owned Directory Contract, not agent inference.
Admin dashboard and .log export are debug surfaces and must not mutate Vault content.

M-001.NAME: MCPServerEntrypoint
M-001.Purpose: Exposes 12 MCP tools over Streamable HTTP, coordinates auth, policy, mutation, retrieval, index-refresh orchestration, and health checks.
M-001.Contracts: All MCP tools wired. Mutation tools return affected_paths and trigger M-014 index refresh (not M-008). Wiki is propose-only. get_instructions returns role-aware Directory Contract. membank_init is non-destructive and audited. Must invoke auth+policy before service operations. Transports to M-020.

M-021.NAME: InstructionService
M-021.Purpose: Builds role-aware AgentMemBank instructions from identity, policy profile and authoritative Directory Contract.
M-021.Contracts: Must include current role, role capabilities, canonical paths, directory purposes, safe workflows, deprecated aliases and drift warnings without exposing secrets.

M-022.NAME: VaultLayoutService
M-022.Purpose: Detects Obsidian vault root and resolves authoritative Directory Contract for all agent-facing folders.
M-022.Contracts: Initial semantic keys are inbox, memory, summaries, wiki, log and system. Generic capture falls back to canonical inbox; ambiguous structured writes require clarification. Deprecated aliases are denied as write targets by default.

M-023.NAME: MemBankInitializationService
M-023.Purpose: Safely checks, plans and applies AgentMemBank Directory Contract initialization over an existing Obsidian Vault.
M-023.Contracts: Must support check_only, dry_run and apply; apply is idempotent, non-destructive, policy-guarded and audited.

M-024.NAME: AdminAuthService
M-024.Purpose: Authenticates human admin dashboard sessions using login/password credentials separate from MCP API keys.
M-024.Contracts: Must never log passwords; MCP API keys must not authenticate admin web sessions.

M-025.NAME: ProcessEventLogService
M-025.Purpose: Records durable structured process events for admin timelines, filtering, report export and trace correlation.
M-025.Contracts: Must record boot, config, auth, MCP, policy, read, mutation, file_change, promotion, index_refresh, sync, backup, init, layout, admin and error events with redaction.

M-026.NAME: LogReportService
M-026.Purpose: Builds sanitized line-oriented .log reports from process and audit events with filters.
M-026.Contracts: Must filter by time, severity, category, event_type, agent_id, admin_user, path_prefix, trace_id, status and error_code; reports must be redacted and size-bounded.

M-027.NAME: AdminDashboardService
M-027.Purpose: Aggregates read-only admin dashboard data for health, timelines, errors, file changes, MCP requests, drift and exports.
M-027.Contracts: Must be read-only, sanitized, session-gated through M-028/M-024 and degrade gracefully if event storage is unavailable.

M-028.NAME: AdminWebInterface
M-028.Purpose: Provides private read-only admin web pages for login, process timeline, filters and .log export.
M-028.Contracts: Must require admin session, remain private-network scoped and never directly access Vault filesystem or audit internals.

M-002.NAME: AuthIdentityService
M-002.Purpose: Resolves agent identity, API key, role and policy profile.
M-002.Contracts: Must reject invalid keys before any Vault access and must never log secrets.

M-003.NAME: VaultPolicyGuard
M-003.Purpose: Enforces allowlist, denylist, no-delete, no-bulk-move, dry-run, propose-only and symlink-deny policies.
M-003.Contracts: Must fail closed on denylist, delete, bulk move, missing dry-run, autonomous 70_Wiki write and symlink acceptance.

M-004.NAME: VaultReadService
M-004.Purpose: Provides safe read/list/exists/metadata operations over allowed Vault paths.
M-004.Contracts: Must return sha256(content) revision with content and must never expose denied paths.

M-005.NAME: VaultFilesystemRepository
M-005.Purpose: Performs normalized path resolution, symlink denial, file reads, metadata inspection and atomic writes.
M-005.Contracts: Must deny traversal and any symlink path or parent component; all resolved paths must remain under Vault root.

M-006.NAME: ChangePlanner
M-006.Purpose: Builds dry-run diffs, validates constrained patches and creates executable mutation plans.
M-006.Contracts: Allowed patch operations are append_under_heading, replace_section, replace_exact_text, replace_exact_block and insert_after_heading.

M-007.NAME: LockAndRevisionService
M-007.Purpose: Provides hybrid locks and sha256(content) optimistic concurrency checks.
M-007.Contracts: Must recompute current revision immediately before write and reject mismatch as conflict.

M-008.NAME: VaultMutationService
M-008.Purpose: Executes approved create/append/edit/write operations through ChangePlanner (M-006), returns affected_paths with unified diff, and never calls index refresh directly.

type-MutationResult.field: Unified diff generated by M-006.prepare_change for ALL mutation types.

M-008.Contracts: Must return affected_paths, audit_event_id AND diff; must not depend on or directly call M-014; must invoke M-006.prepare_change for ALL operations including create_note and write_note; _authorize_or_raise must forward actual dry_run parameter, never hardcode True.

M-009.NAME: AuditLogService
M-009.Purpose: Writes authoritative machine-readable audit events and updates LOG.md projection.
M-009.Contracts: Audit event must include event_id, timestamp, agent_id, operation, path, revisions, dry_run, profile, result, affected_paths and trace_id.

M-010.NAME: RetrievalService
M-010.Purpose: Provides keyword, FTS, optional semantic, similar-notes, wiki-source retrieval and explainable ranking.
M-010.Contracts: Must filter denied paths after querying derivative indexes and must degrade to FTS when vector mode is disabled.

M-011.NAME: ConfigService
M-011.Purpose: Loads server, Vault, auth, policy, index, audit and backup configuration.
M-011.Contracts: Unsafe or incomplete config must fail closed; secrets must not be logged. API keys may be loaded from env (api_keys_from_env) with JSON-safe redaction.

M-012.NAME: ObservabilityService
M-012.Purpose: Provides structured logs, request IDs, trace anchors and error taxonomy.
M-012.Contracts: Critical operations must emit trace anchors with trace_id and safe structured fields.

M-013.NAME: IndexRepository
M-013.Purpose: Maintains SQLite metadata, FTS5, audit-index access and future vector tables derived from Vault files.
M-013.Contracts: Must initialize SQLite WAL, busy_timeout, FTS5 schema and revision-aware index_state.

M-014.NAME: IndexRefreshService
M-014.Purpose: Rebuilds or incrementally updates the index from Vault content and affected_paths.
M-014.Contracts: Must treat Vault as source of truth and must be invoked by M-001 or background worker, not M-008.

M-015.NAME: MarkdownSemanticParser
M-015.Purpose: Extracts frontmatter, tags, links, headings, sections and validates post-apply Markdown shape.
M-015.Contracts: Parser output must be stable for indexing, patch validation and wiki source extraction.

M-016.NAME: VectorSearchAdapter
M-016.Purpose: Provides optional vector search via disabled/sqlite-vec/qdrant-optional implementations.
M-016.Contracts: Disabled mode must require no external dependency and vector failures must degrade to FTS.

M-017.NAME: BackupService
M-017.Purpose: Exposes manual Git backup/health integration without implementing rollback API in MVP.
M-017.Contracts: Must not implement restore_note_revision or mutate Vault content as rollback in MVP.

M-018.NAME: WikiUpdateService
M-018.Purpose: Finds wiki sources and generates propose-only diffs for 70_Wiki.
M-018.Contracts: Must never write directly to 70_Wiki; output is source-linked diff proposal.

M-019.NAME: DraftPromotionService
M-019.Purpose: Controls single-note promote/move workflows from inbox or future drafts to approved destinations.
M-019.Contracts: Must be single-file, trusted-only, dry-run required, no overwrite, no denylisted folder.

M-020.NAME: MCPTransport
M-020.Purpose: Provides aiohttp-based Streamable HTTP MCP transport with JSON-RPC 2.0 handling, Bearer token auth, and MCP method routing (initialize, tools/list, tools/call, ping).
M-020.Contracts: Must accept JSON-RPC 2.0 over POST /message; Bearer token from Authorization header; MCP version 2024-11-05. GET /health returns server health non-JSON-RPC.

GraphIntegrity.constraint: Every M-xxx node has a verification-ref V-M-xxx.
Every public interface annotation is public contract only; private helpers are intentionally excluded.
Forbidden direct dependency M-008 -> M-014 must remain absent in implementation.
CrossLinks are navigational and do not override the dependency DAG in development-plan.xml.
Directory Contract nodes must cover all agent-facing write destinations before get_instructions is considered complete.
Admin dashboard nodes must remain read-only and must not bypass service aggregation to access Vault filesystem.
